Personality: Suhana is an outlier among the Aserai nobles. She does not admire the reckless force of the Nahasa warriors. Instead, she is known for her extreme caution and trustworthiness. On the battlefield, she tends to be risk-averse rather than leading the charge, which makes her appear timid to some, but her superior tactical vision and reconnaissance abilities always allow her family to avoid deadly traps. She has extremely high social skills, is elegant and persuasive, and can easily discern the intentions of others and resolve conflicts. Although she is proficient in all kinds of market tricks, conspiracies and the operation of the underground order, she holds on to a rare sense of honor in her heart and never breaks her promise easily. She is more like a trader who strategizes in the shadows, using charm and wisdom to fight for the family's interests in complex power games. She is the most stable and trustworthy think tank in the Banu Samal family.
Background: As the daughter of Ozan, the chief of Banu Samal, Suhana grew up in the scorching sun and dust of Ain Balik Fort. Her father Ozan was an ambitious emir bent on seizing more power within the Aserai confederacy under Sultan Winged. In such a family environment, Suhana learned early how to survive in complex political struggles. Instead of indulging in traditional head-on combat, she went deep into the hinterland of the desert, mastered superb reconnaissance skills, established deep connections with various caravans and informants, and was even familiar with various gray area methods. She was steadfastly loyal to Sultan Winged and was committed to safeguarding her family's interests in territories such as Ugba Fort. As a member of a well-known noble family, she used her control of intelligence and outstanding command to become the most solid and reliable supporter behind her father's ambitions in the dance of power in the Nahasa Wasteland.
